title: rate.latest
description: The latest aggregated rate of a pair (SRS 4.1.5, 4.1.9). The topic is compacted by pair; rate-service restores its cache from it after a restart. A rate older than 60 s is stale.

price.description: USD for one whole unit of the base currency, a decimal string.

quotedAt.description: Time of the quote the rate is based on; the age of the rate is counted from it.

sources.description: Sources the price is aggregated from: both exchanges that answered, or the one left.
